[EN] My brother's still missing. It should have been me, but he gave me his pass so I was in Castanica. I'm not going back until I find him or they bring his body back.

Our parents will never forgive me.
[ES] Mi hermano sigue desaparecido. Debí ser yo, pero me dio su pase y yo estaba en Castanica. No regresaré hasta encontrarlo o hasta que traigan su cuerpo.

Nuestros padres nunca me perdonarán.
